facts.subject: main/melee/ft/ftcoll:ftColl_80077464
facts.old_value: The handler has two mutually exclusive outcomes. If incoming damage is greater than the reflector's `maxDamage`, reflection is rejected as an overload: the item retains the largest applicable damage value, the fighter records `damageOver`, and no reflecting owner or reflection multipliers are installed. Otherwise reflection succeeds: the item records the fighter as its reflector, receives ownership/state values plus damage and speed multipliers, and inherits two fighter flags. In both outcomes, `item->xC68` points away from the fighter relative to the item's position, while `reflectHitDirection` opposes nonzero item X velocity or falls back to the item-versus-fighter position when X velocity is zero.
facts.reason: Inherited flag-copy wording misses the one-way set of item flag b1; no direct owner/velocity mutation occurs here.
facts.replacement_value: Converts damage by truncation, replacing a nonzero value whose integer cast is zero with 1. Values above maxDamage update the selected item damage maximum and fighter damageOver; other values install reflector GObj, metadata and multipliers. Success copies xDCC_flag.b2 but only sets b1 when the fighter flag is true, leaving prior b1 unchanged otherwise. Both branches derive item direction from relative X and reflector direction opposite nonzero item X velocity or from relative X.
